data.one_liner: Cache Manager and Cached ImageProvider for Firebase Cloud Storage Objects.
data.what_it_does: Provides a Flutter ImageProvider and a cache manager to download, cache, pre-cache, and manage files and images from Firebase Cloud Storage. It supports local device storage on mobile/desktop and IndexedDB on the web.
use_when: You need to display images directly from Firebase Cloud Storage with caching.
You need to download, cache, and manage non-image files stored in Firebase Storage.
You want configurable caching policies like expiration times or server check intervals.
avoid_when: You are loading images from general URLs rather than Firebase Cloud Storage.
You do not use Firebase in your application.
strengths: Seamless integration with Firebase Cloud Storage via gs://, HTTP URLs, or Storage References.
Includes both an ImageProvider for widgets and a cache manager for generic files and bytes.
weaknesses: Some cache clearing methods and file copying features are not supported on the web.
Checking for server file updates incurs Class B Google Cloud Storage metadata operations which may cost money after free tiers.
data.setup_notes: Requires setting up Firebase in your Flutter project. Web support requires setting FirebaseCacheManagerConfig.webSupport = true.
